_comment: C libraries that wheels link into their native modules, reviewed by hand (static-licenses.mjs adds each to the dist's record with its text). Keys are normalized distribution names. `detect` is a regular expression whose first group reads the library's version from the binary; without it, `version` says what is known. `text` is where the licence text comes from ({version} is filled in). A distribution listed here needs a record for its exact version or the stage fails.

cryptography.name: OpenSSL
cryptography.why: cryptography's wheels link OpenSSL into hazmat/bindings/_rust (its version string is in the binary); the wheel's own LICENSE does not name it

cffi.name: libffi
cffi.why: _cffi_backend exports ffi_prep_cif and loads no libffi: libffi is linked in; cffi's LICENSE does not name it

ruamel-yaml-clib.name: libyaml
ruamel-yaml-clib.why: _ruamel_yaml exports libyaml's yaml_* functions from the copy ruamel.yaml.clib compiles in; its LICENSE names only ruamel
